## Constraints & Preferences

- No agent marked complete until it passed security+QA and performs real work
- **Owner order (latest, supersedes freeze)**: APPROVED removal of standalone Kotlin app `android-ivx-holdings/` ONLY; do NOT delete Expo-required native project (`expo/android/`); preserve any Kotlin file needed by Expo/EAS; backup + rollback tag BEFORE changes; after cleanup run full Expo Android build + verify owner login/members/investors/buyers/deals/reels/chat/notifications; return files removed, files preserved, commit SHA, build result, APK status, AAB status, exact evidence; never create another mobile app; single Expo codebase for Android/iOS/Web

- Management API SQL: `POST https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/kvclcdjmjghndxsngfzb/database/query` `{"query":"..."}`; multi-statement = one transaction; ~55s timeout; token `/tmp/sbp_token`
- Owner session refresh: `POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=refresh_token` with `/tmp/owner_rt` → `/tmp/owner_at`; anon `/tmp/anon`; service-role `/tmp/srk`
- Local shell has NO env vars (no GITHUB_TOKEN, no EXPO_TOKEN); Android SDK IS present at `/opt/android-sdk` (java 17, gradle 8.14.3); 2h executive reports to IVX AI Chat (conversation `8f5a9c42-1cb5-4f81-b2d8-6f3a0a8b9d41`, owner sender `9b280e15-f9fd-459f-bf2d-530b1ed84cb1`, `messages` table)
